blocks.title: Class and object
blocks.text: A class is a template for creating things, and an object is an actual thing made from that template. Each object is an instance of the class, with its own values.

To make a toy car you first need a blueprint describing its colour, size, number of wheels and material. The blueprint is not a car; it is the class. Cars made from it, each with its own colour or size, are the objects you can play with.
